response.sql: WITH project_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) as rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE s.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) as avg_rate FROM project_rates) SELECT pr.arcref, pr.fundflux, pr.rate, (pr.rate - b.avg_rate) as gap FROM project_rates pr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE pr.rate > b.avg_rate ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
